description: This file defines tools for network request management within a browser automation context, including listing requests, clearing requests, setting network state, and utility functions for request analysis.

methods.name: isSuccessfulResponse
methods.description: Checks if a network request has a successful response (status code less than 400) and did not fail.

methods.name: isFetch
methods.description: Determines if a request is a fetch or xhr request.

methods.name: renderRequest
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a network request, including method, URL, and response status or failure reason.
